entries.226c1840f28eafc9: Companies requiring support in the IT infrastructure area or introduction of RPA
entries.3e25e87911dc0be7: A company that designs, builds, operates and maintains communications infrastructure and IoT equipment for infrastructure operators such as telecommunications, electric power and gas, and also provides a cloud service that makes fieldwork more efficient.
entries.4378db9f20627b2b: This service builds, operates and maintains mobile phone infrastructure and networks. It provides area design, siting and construction of base stations, integration that enables base stations to transmit radio waves, and operation monitoring and maintenance; its strength lies in project support work carried out resident at clients' sites. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,252 million.
entries.59f69f362d691a2f: This is a single-segment business, conducted by the company and one consolidated subsidiary (Avanse Ajiru Co., Ltd.), that provides design, construction, operation and maintenance of telecommunications and IoT infrastructure, along with various project support services, to infrastructure operators such as telecommunications, electric power and gas companies. Combining its know-how in building telecommunications infrastructure with its in-house developed field-work DX cloud “BLAS” as well as AI and RPA, it provides field operations outsourcing (BPO) and SaaS in an integrated manner under the form of “BPaaS,” delivering end-to-end service from infrastructure construction through operation and maintenance. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥8,427 million.
entries.c0e95a247048e8a5: Drawing on know-how developed in field operations for both mobile and IoT services, this service provides engineering in the IT infrastructure area, such as servers and networks, sells RPA tools, provides RPA implementation support, and sells “BLAS” to external customers. Revenue from the staffing business of consolidated subsidiary Avanse Ajiru Co., Ltd. is also included in this category. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥1,431 million.
entries.d74b13e6a521987e: Utility infrastructure operators, such as electric power and gas companies
entries.d93cc8d365857117: This service builds, operates and maintains IoT infrastructure and networks. For IoT devices such as smart meters, temperature sensors, network cameras, digital signage and EV charging equipment, it provides services from specification review and device installation work through operation, monitoring and maintenance. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥3,742 million, the largest of the service categories.
entries.ef46a0bb4f02e1eb: Operators of facilities such as railways, parking lots and retail stores
